αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.

αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.

γέροντι: γέρων — old man; masc. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γνοίη: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he or she recognise’
γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman; fem. nom. pl., in apposition to δμωαί: ’women’ · also fem. nom. pl. in a pair: ’women’ (ἀνέρες ἠδὲ γυναῖκες ’men and women’)
δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’
δίδοσαν: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδοσαν): ’they kept giving’
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg.
δαιτρὸς: δαιτρός — carver, one who portions out meat; nom. sg. (from δαίομαι ’divide’)
δαιτῶν: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. pl.
διδοῖ: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δίδωσι)
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δμῶες: δμώς — servant, slave (male); masc. nom. pl.
δούλιον: δούλιος — of a slave, of slavery; neut. acc. sg.
δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl.: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’

εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσῆλθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. 3 sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. εἴροντο: ἐρέομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they asked’
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
εἶς: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — epithet of Zeus, literal sense disputed (’wide-voiced’ or ’far-seeing’); masc. nom. sg. in short -α
εὔμαι: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὔμαι’ = Εὔμαιε)
εὔμαιε: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg.
εὔχεται: εὔχομαι — claim, boast, profess; pres. 3 sg.: ’claims (to be)’ · also pray, + dat.: ’prays’ (Διὶ δ’ εὔχεται ’and to Zeus he prays’)
εὖθ: εὖτε — when; conj., elided and aspirated (εὖθ’ = εὖτε)
εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’
θέειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖν)
θέσπιν: θέσπις — god-given, inspired; fem. acc. sg.
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θανόντος: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. gen. sg. (aor. ἔθανον): ’dead’, lit. ’having died’
θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. nom. sg.
θεοειδὴς: θεοειδής — godlike in form; masc. nom. sg.
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’
θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg.
κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, order, urge; pres. 1 sg.

κακότητος: κακότης — evil, misery, wretchedness; fem. gen. sg.
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
καλέσας: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having called’
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
καλὸς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. sg., attributive (also of a harbour)
κατέδουσιν: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίουσιν)
κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, put away, store; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist) ’put away’
κατέθηκεν: κατατίθημι — put down, stow; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’put down, stowed’
κατέλειπεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; impf. 3 sg., + acc.

κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘lying’
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.

κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κρέας: κρέας — flesh, meat; neut. acc. sg.: ’a portion of meat’
κόπρῳ: κόπρος — dung, manure; fem. dat. sg.
κύων: κύων — dog; masc./fem. nom. sg. (common gender)
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαερτιάδην: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
λευγαλέῳ: λευγαλέος — pitiful, sorry, miserable; masc. dat. sg.
λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl. (grave, mid-clause form): ’grievous things’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάντιν: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. acc. sg.
μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc./neut. gen. sg.

μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μελάνθιος: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. nom. sg. (beside the by-form Μελανθεύς)
μενοινᾷ: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; pres. 3 sg.

μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)

μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’

νόημα: νόημα — thought, notion, idea; neut. nom. sg.
ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.

οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
οἷοί: οἷος — such as, of the kind that; masc. nom. pl., correlative/relative, accented before the enclitic τε
οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντοσε: πάντοσε — in every direction, all round; adv.
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’) · also preposition with anastrophe + gen.: ’about, concerning’ (φόνου πέρι ’about slaughter’)
παρεῖναι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand, be with (someone); pres. inf.: ’to be with, to be present’
παρισταμένη: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come to one’s side; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περικαλλέος: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. gen. sg.
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; neut. nom./acc. sg., exclamatory: ’what a thing!’
προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front, in one’s presence; adv.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόλινδε: πόλις — city; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’to the city’
σίγα: σιγάω — be silent; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be quiet!’
στάθμην: στάθμη — carpenter’s line or rule, for marking a straight edge; fem. acc. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σταθμῷ: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. dat. sg.
συβῶτα: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. voc. sg., epic -α (in apposition to Εὔμαιε)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τίη: τίη — why?; interrog. adv., epic (= Attic τί)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg. (θείειν ταχύς ’swift to run’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσειε: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish with μή: ’may he not bring to pass’
τηλέμαχ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Τηλέμαχ’ = Τηλέμαχε)
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλέμαχός: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg. (accented before enclitic θ’)
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself) · also gen. governed by μεσσηγύς ’between’ (νηός τε καὶ αὐτοῦ Τηλεμάχοιο ’the ship and Telemachus himself’)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τινές: τις, τι — someone, something; masc./fem. nom. pl. (accented before an enclitic) · after a relative, οἵ τινες (= οἵτινες) is the pl. of ὅστις: ’who, whoever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with νόημα: ’such (a thought)’
τοιόσδ: τοιόσδε — such, of this kind; masc. nom. sg., elided τοιόσδ’: ’such (a man)’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τροίηνδε: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with directional suffix -δε: ‘to Troy’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε)
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄεθλον) · also acc. sg. agreeing with ὄλεθρον: ’this destruction’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., + gen.: ’far from’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), gen. with ἐνιπλησθῆναι
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φαγέμεν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. φαγεῖν; inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φαγεῖν): ’to eat’
φθονέω: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge (+ gen. of the thing); pres. 1 sg.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φῶτα: φώς — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg.
χαλεποῖσιν: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
χροΐ: χρώς — skin, body; masc. dat. sg., epic χροΐ (= Attic χρωτί)
ἀγακλειτῆς: ἀγακλειτός — very glorious, famed; fem. gen. sg.
ἀγειρόμενοι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering (together)’
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀγχίμολον: ἀγχίμολος — coming near, close at hand; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’close by, hard upon’
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀείδων: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, valour; fem. acc. sg.
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀντίνο: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀντίνο’ = Ἀντίνοε)
ἀντίνοον: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. acc. sg.
ἀντίνοος: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’opposite, facing’ (ἀντίον Εὐρυμάχου ’opposite Eurymachus’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀοιδόν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
ἀοιδός: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
ἀοιδὸς: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
ἀπόπροθεν: ἀπόπροθεν — from afar, far off; adv.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, worth (of a person); fem. gen. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’)
ἄειδεν: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾖδε(ν))
ἄκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of the thing heard
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
ἄνακτες: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. pl.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄσχετε: ἄσχετος — not to be held back, unchecked (ἀ- + σχετός; epic also ἀάσχετος); masc. voc. sg.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’
ἐδύσετο: δύω/δύνω — enter, sink into, plunge; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic sigmatic (ἐδύσετο, = Attic ἔδυ): ’she plunged (in)’
ἐεικοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; epic ἐεικοστός (prothetic ε-), masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἐθάμβεον: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; impf. 3 pl.
ἐθέλουσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); neut. acc. pl.
ἐναίσιμοι: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); masc. nom. pl.
ἐναλίγκιος: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνιαυτῷ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time when
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’)
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
ἐπικρατέωσιν: ἐπικρατέω — rule, hold sway; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπικρατῶσιν), after ὅτ(ε) without ἄν
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐποτρύνει: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. 3 sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; pres. inf. mid., of purpose: ’to work (for)’
ἐρεθιζέμεν: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, rouse; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν): ’to provoke’
ἐρχόμενον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as he went’
ἐρύκοι: ἐρύκω — keep off, ward off, hold back; pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε in a relative clause: ’which would keep off’
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐχέφρων: Ἐχέφρων — Echephron, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg. · also the adj. ἐχέφρων — sensible, prudent (ἔχω + φρήν); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’ · also ’taking hold of, seizing’ (γούναθ’ ἑλών ’grasping the knees’)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων)
ἔμελλ: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ fut. inf.); impf. 3 sg., elided (ἔμελλ’ = ἔμελλε)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχεται: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling to, depend on; pres. 3 sg. mid., with ἐκ + gen.: ’is dependent on’
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕνεκεν: ἕνεκα (ἕνεκεν) — for the sake of, on account of; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun (τῆς ἕνεκεν ’for whose sake’)
ἕστο: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on, wear; plpf. 3 sg. mid., epic, + acc.: ’he was wearing, he had put on’
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἡγεμόνευεν: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, guide; impf. 3 sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἤγαγες: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 2 sg. (reduplicated 2nd aorist), augmented: ’you led’
ἤσθιε: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 sg.: ’was eating, ate’
ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἧμιν: ἐγώ — I, we; dat. pl., epic ἧμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’ · also ’until’ + optative, of an expected end (ἧος θερμαίνοιτο ’until it should grow hot’)
ἧός: ἧος — until, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως), accented before the enclitic με
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε) · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (printed the same; Attic accents it ἰδέ): ἴδε πῶμα ’look at the lid’
ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀρέγων: ὀρέγω — stretch out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’stretching out’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁμάδησαν: ὁμαδέω — make a din, clamor; aor. 3 pl.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
ὑψαγόρη: ὑψαγόρης — loud-talker, boaster (ὕψι + ἀγορεύω); masc. voc. sg.
ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
ὤτρυν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir up; aor. or impf. 3 sg., elided (ὤτρυν’ = ὤτρυνε)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι) · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for those toward whom’ (ᾗσι τ’ ἐὺ φρονέῃσι ’for those toward whom she is well disposed’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
